# Timbrana

> Timbrana is construction project management software built around Project Awareness for general contractors. It connects field activity, decisions, responsibility and follow-through so the project team can understand what changed, what matters now, what is waiting, who has the next responsibility and what happens next.

## Project Awareness
Project Awareness is a current understanding of the project — not only a record of what happened. It keeps the active meaning of daily logs, calls, RFIs, change orders, owner questions, deliveries, inspections and field issues connected as the work changes.

Documentation tells the team what happened. Project Awareness helps the team understand what that means for the project now.

## Product boundaries
Timbrana focuses on project execution and awareness. It is not positioned as accounting, estimating or payroll software.

## Access
Timbrana is designed so internal construction-team coordination can remain internal while owners or clients see the requests, questions, decisions and statuses appropriate to them.
